alternatives.Tessellation: Use LOD Groups instead of tessellation for VR performance
alternatives.Geometry Shaders: Use compute shaders or vertex shaders for particle effects
alternatives.Surface Shaders (complex): Use URP Lit/Simple Lit with Single Pass Instanced support
alternatives.Heavy Post-Processing (SSAO, SSR, Motion: Disable Motion Blur (causes nausea), use baked AO, limit post-processing to Bloom and Color Grading

disallowedAPIs: Unity.XR.Oculus.* (OculusXR package deprecated/being removed per Unity's public roadmap — verify current status via manage_packages(action: "list_packages") before assuming; migrate to com.unity.xr.openxr regardless)
HoloLens 2 plug-in APIs (platform support and plug-in deprecated in Unity 6.4 — migrate to the OpenXR plug-in)

graphicsApi.notes: Two XR deprecations with different confidence levels. (1) DOCUMENTED FOR UNITY 6.4: HoloLens 2 platform support and its plug-in are deprecated; the documented migration path is the OpenXR plug-in (https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/upgrade-guides/upgrade-guide-unity64, retrieved 2026-10-21). (2) REPORTED, REMOVAL RELEASE UNVERIFIED: Unity's public communications describe the OculusXR package as deprecated and slated for removal in a later 6.x Update release, in favour of the OpenXR Plugin package -- the deprecation is reported, but the removal release was NOT verified against a project with the package installed, so do not cite a version number for it. Confirm actual package presence via manage_packages(action: "list_packages") for the specific project rather than assuming from a version number; the call is asynchronous, so poll manage_packages(action: "status", job_id: ...) with the returned job_id. The URP GPU Resident Drawer is unsupported on VisionOS regardless of Graphics API; verify compute shader support per headset/runtime before enabling it.

renderingConstraints.foveatedRendering: Enable Fixed Foveated Rendering on supported HMDs

comfortGuidelines.locomotion: Use teleportation or tunneling vignette to reduce motion sickness
comfortGuidelines.frameDrops: Any frame drop below target causes discomfort — maintain consistent frame rate
comfortGuidelines.uiPlacement: Place UI at 1-3 meters distance, avoid UI attached to head movement
comfortGuidelines.audioSpatialization: Use spatial audio for immersion and comfort
